How mods work Everything happens on the server In Hytale, even singleplayer runs on a local server of your own. So when the studio talks about servers, it means both cases. The core principle, laid out by technical director Slikey in November 2025, is server side first . You can join any modded server without downloading external mods or client packs. In singleplayer, you pick the mods for each save. The idea goes back to 2019. The server technology post already said that when you join a server, the client automatically downloads everything it needs: models, animations, sounds and the rest. Data assets: JSON files that define blocks, items, NPCs, world generation, drop tables and loot. Art assets: models, textures and sounds, made with Blockbench. Its argument is that a scripting language is still programming: programmers end up juggling two languages, and non programmers still have to learn programming concepts. The chosen path is visual scripting , inspired by Unreal's Blueprints. Designers build logic visually, and programmers add new nodes in Java. Visual scripting has not been released yet. Before Hytale 2011 to 2014 The adventure maps Simon Collins Laflamme, known in Minecraft as "hypixel", and Philippe Touchette, aka Rezzus, started out making adventure maps. Let's plays ruled YouTube at the time, and the duo's maps had boss fights and redstone contraptions. In April 2020, Simon wrote that it had been nine years since the two of them launched Hypixel. That puts the start of the brand in 2011. In a 2018 interview with Rock Paper Shotgun, Simon described the problem that changed everything. Players knew how to install the maps, but they didn't know how to find their friends to play. The answer was to open a server. The Hypixel server The Hypixel server opened in April 2013. Players showed up by the thousands, and the team started betting on minigames. They were short matches to kill time while friends logged in, like The Walls, Bed Wars and UHC. They ended up more popular than the rest of the server. Hypixel collected four Guinness World Records. One is the most popular independent server for a videogame, with 64,533 concurrent players. Another is the most unique players logged into a Minecraft server, with 14.1 million. The EULA wake up call In 2014, Mojang began enforcing the Minecraft license rules against selling gameplay advantages on servers. Aaron "Noxy" Donaghey, who would later run the studio, told Rock Paper Shotgun the episode was a reminder. Hypixel had a huge community, but it lived on someone else's playing field. The team wanted a field of its own. There was a technical reason too. Turbo Kart Racer, a Mario Kart style racing minigame, struggled because the Minecraft camera couldn't pull back far enough, and players spun out without knowing why. With their own engine, limits like that would go away. The secret years 2015 to 2018 Development of Hytale began in 2015, funded by the server's success. The date is in the Hypixel Studios founding press release, published on December 13, 2018. The game team split off from the server team. The official FAQ from December 2018 says this had happened "over two years" earlier. In 2016, according to the same founding press release, Riot Games met the team. The person saying so is Dylan Jadeja, then president of Riot. Remember that name. Hypixel Studios was formally founded in 2018, separate from Hypixel Inc., which still runs the server. The money came from an investor group led by Riot, with names like Dennis "Thresh" Fong and designer Rob Pardo. At the announcement, the studio had more than 40 developers spread around the world. The reveal December 2018 On Sunday, December 9, 2018, the Hytale website got a countdown, and the Hypixel community spent the week guessing what was coming.
